items.label: Eversource press release: ISO New England selects Eversource's joint transmission (09-16-2026)
items.signal_prefix: ISO New England selected Eversource's joint Transmission Ini

set.signal: ISO New England selected Eversource's joint Transmission Initiative Down East (TIDE) project as the preferred longer-term transmission solution in its competitive transmission solicitation. TIDE expands transmission capacity between Maine and New Hampshire and would allow up to 1,200 megawatts of future onshore wind generation in northern New England to integrate into the regional grid. Eversource's portion is mainly upgrades within existing New Hampshire rights-of-way, with additional work in Maine and Massachusetts: a new 18-mile, 345 kilovolt (kV) line, a rebuild of one existing 345 kV line, reconductoring of another, and voltage/power-quality equipment. Construction is anticipated to begin in 2029, pending all state and regulatory approvals and after engineering, environmental and permitting reviews. No project cost stated in the release.

items.reason: The release never mentions an earlier preliminary selection; that parenthetical is background not stated in the source.
items.evidence: Eversource today announced ISO New England's (ISO-NE) selection of the company's joint Transmission Initiative Down East (TIDE) project as the preferred longer-term transmission solution

items.label: Eaton Morgan Stanley laguna conference 2026 (09-16-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Demand and backlog (Ruiz): he confirmed data-center orders u

set.signal: Demand and backlog (Ruiz): he confirmed data-center orders up 85% and revenues up 65%; the data-center negotiation pipeline is up over 130% (total negotiation pipeline up 60%). Announced data-center projects were 307 gigawatts when Eaton released Q2 and '342' when checked this week, versus 50 gigawatts installed today ('between six and seven times'); most will not turn into 2027-2028 revenue - 'a longer cycle'. Electrical Global: APAC and EMEA each growing 20% organically and global energy infrastructure high teens; Electrical Global backlogs were up 103% year-over-year; asked how much was Boyd, he said 'Boyd was half of the backlog' - excluding Boyd, the legacy Electrical Global businesses grew backlog 54%. Utilities: new gas-turbine generation 'is going to turn into transmission already now', and into utility distribution business for Eaton in the next couple of years. 'I don't expect a large slowdown anytime soon.'

items.reason: As written it reads as Boyd being half of the segment's backlog level; the CEO was answering how much of the 103% backlog growth came from Boyd (ex-Boyd growth 54%). Restore the context.
items.evidence: the backlogs were up 103% year-over-year. ... 'Well, Paulo, how much of that was Boyd?' Boyd was half of the backlog. If you deduct Boyd, the traditional legacy Eaton businesses in electrical global grew backlog 54%.
